_notice: Built by build_live_shelf.py from [MASTER] 202610 Advised Portfolios Performance.xlsx (tabs: Performance - Linked, RHP, RHP - MDD, SGD TER). Returns, drawdown, volatility and fees are from the workbook; asset class, sub-class and risk rating are derived.
limitations: Asset class is derived from the workbook's RHP sections (alternatives) or the fund name (everything else); the workbook has no asset-class column.
Risk rating (1-5) is derived from annualised volatility, with a floor of 4 for private markets and gold and 3 for hedge funds; it is not an official product risk rating.

management_fee is the annual management fee (AMF) and total_expense_ratio the TER, both from the SGD TER tab by exact ISIN; funds not in that tab have no fee. Fees are for information only and are never used to rank.
Yields, sector and geographic exposure, ESG status, currency hedging and eligibility are not in the source tabs and are left empty.
Dealing frequency and lock-ins for alternative funds are not in the source tabs; they are left empty and must be confirmed before recommending.
Returns for periods longer than a fund's track record are omitted.
Equities and fixed income are picked per style bucket (shown as the sub-asset class), best Sharpe within each bucket, SGD or USD share classes only.
Fewer qualifying funds than targeted for: Gold (4), Real estate (6).
